description: This file defines an Android activity 'Bouncer1' with an inner custom view 'MyView' that displays a bitmap and animates its vertical position using a ValueAnimator for a bouncing effect.

classes.name: Bouncer1
classes.description: Main activity class that sets the content view.

classes.name: MyView
classes.description: Custom View that displays a bitmap and animates its vertical position with a bouncing animation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout.

methods.name: setShapeX
methods.description: Sets the X position of the shape and invalidates the affected area.

methods.name: setShapeY
methods.description: Sets the Y position of the shape and invalidates the affected area.

methods.name: setupShape
methods.description: Loads the bitmap resource and sets up click listener to start animation.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Centers the shape horizontally when the view size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the bitmap at the current position.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts an infinite reverse bouncing animation.

methods.name: getValueAnimator
methods.description: Creates a ValueAnimator that updates the shape's Y position based on animation progress.
